item.title: Correction · Mission Bay South Block 15A (UCSF planned): Block 15A's notes said the block is surface parking (satellite-confirmed) and designated for UCSF institutional use, citing only the 2019 land use map, which shows neither. They now say the parking is our own observation in USDA NAIP imagery and cite UCSF's June 2025 CAC deck (undeveloped, Block 15 – Housing), and the use is corrected from institutional to residential. The 2019 milestone now cites the December 2015 property management plan map for the undivided block and drops two unverifiable clauses.
item.description: Block 15A's notes said the block is surface parking (satellite-confirmed) and designated for UCSF institutional use, citing only the 2019 land use map, which shows neither. They now say the parking is our own observation in USDA NAIP imagery and cite UCSF's June 2025 CAC deck (undeveloped, Block 15 – Housing), and the use is corrected from institutional to residential. The 2019 milestone now cites the December 2015 property management plan map for the undivided block and drops two unverifiable clauses. Source: UCSF Mission Bay Development Overview, Mission Bay CAC, 2025-06-12 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/2025-06/Item%202%20-%20UCSF%20Mission%20Bay%20Development%20Overview.pdf); USDA NAIP imagery, viewed 2026-09-29 (https://apps.geo.fpac.usda.gov/geo-imagery/rest/services/naip/conus_naip/ImageServer); OCII Mission Bay Long-Range Property Management Plan, Attachment B map, 2015-12 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/02%20Mission%20Bay.pdf).

item.title: Milestone · Mission Bay South Block 15A (UCSF planned): UCSF's September 13, 2016 Note to File analysed temporary contractor parking on Blocks 15 and 16 (recounted in Addendum #4); a separate September 26, 2016 notice covers wet-utility piping and surface work 'in and adjacent to' Blocks 14, 15, 16 and 18 (~2016)

item.title: Planned · Mission Bay South Block 15A (UCSF planned): UC Regents certify the 2014 Long Range Development Plan Environmental Impact Report (November 20, 2014) and approve the plan; the report analysed new housing and a relocated child care facility on Block 15 (as recounted in the 2017 addenda). UCSF's documents name the block 'Block 15' without an A/B split (Nov 2014)
